name.local: 國泰創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: CVC arm of Cathay Financial Holdings (Taiwan's largest insurance-led financial group, non-healthcare core business); invests across four pillars — emerging technologies, biotech & healthcare, fintech, and overseas quality deals — with biotech focus on next-generation antibody drugs (ADC, bispecifics) and AI-assisted diagnostics/treatment solutions.

summary.en: Corporate VC arm of Cathay Financial Holdings (insurance/banking group) that targets biotech & healthcare alongside emerging tech, fintech and overseas deals, with a stated focus on next-generation antibody drugs and AI-assisted diagnostics.
summary.local: 國泰金控旗下創投，聚焦新興科技、生技醫療、金融科技與海外優質標的，生技面重點關注ADC、多特異性抗體等新世代抗體藥物，並關注AI輔助診斷與治療解決方案。

sources.title: 國泰創投
sources.supports: founding year 2003, four investment pillars, biotech/AI-diagnostics thesis
sources.quote: 聚焦於創新生技藥品領域，特別關注抗體藥物複合體(ADC)、多特異性抗體等新世代抗體藥物

name.local: 富邦金控創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: CVC of Fubon Financial Holdings (insurance/banking/securities conglomerate, non-healthcare core); invests domestically and overseas in biotech/healthcare, green energy technology, AI and new materials, often via joint ventures or minority stakes in high-growth unlisted companies.

summary.en: Venture capital subsidiary of Fubon Financial Holdings (Taiwan's insurance-led financial conglomerate), owned by Fubon Life, Fubon Property & Casualty Insurance and Fubon Securities, investing in biotech/healthcare alongside green energy, AI and new materials.
summary.local: 富邦金控旗下創投子公司，由富邦金控、富邦人壽、富邦產險及富邦證券共同出資，投資領域涵蓋國內外生技醫療、綠能科技、人工智慧及新材料科技。

strategy.thesis: Private equity/venture arm of CDIB Financial Holding (formerly China Development Industrial Bank, a diversified financial-holding non-healthcare-core parent); biomedical is a stated priority sector, with dedicated healthcare fund vehicles and investments spanning cell/gene therapy, novel drugs and precision oncology.

summary.en: Venture/private-equity arm of CDIB Financial Holding (banking-rooted financial group); names biomedical as a priority sector and has led rounds in cell-therapy company Acepodia, alongside reported dedicated healthcare fund vehicles (生醫基金, 生醫貳基金).

name.local: 兆豐創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: VC subsidiary of Mega Financial Holding (banking group, non-healthcare core); management has been directed to hire more staff with biotech/healthcare backgrounds as part of Taiwan's '5+2' strategic-industries focus, and has backed multiple biotech financing rounds.

summary.en: Venture capital subsidiary of Mega Financial Holding (a banking-rooted financial group); has been directed to strengthen biotech/healthcare investment expertise under Taiwan's '5+2' industry policy and participates in biopharma financing rounds such as 暻裕生醫 and 思捷優達.

name.local: 廣達電腦股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Quanta Computer, one of the world's top-5 laptop ODMs (non-healthcare core), has diversified into smart healthcare (its own ISO13485-certified QOCA health devices/solutions) and become the largest institutional shareholder (~15%) of AI digital-pathology/endoscopy startup aetherAI (雲象科技), reflecting Taiwan ICT majors' strategic push into AI-driven medical imaging.

notable_investments.outcome: active; listed on Taipei Exchange emerging board 2025

summary.en: Taiwan's major notebook/server ODM has invested directly (as largest institutional shareholder, ~15%) in AI medical-imaging startup aetherAI and develops its own ISO13485-certified smart-healthcare product line, illustrating a Taiwan ICT conglomerate's strategic entry into digital health.
summary.local: 全球前五大筆電代工廠廣達電腦，直接投資AI醫療影像新創雲象科技並為最大法人股東（持股約15%），同時自行開發通過ISO13485認證的QOCA智慧健康產品線。

name.local: 鴻準精密工業股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Foxconn Technology (鴻準精密工業, the precision-casing/manufacturing arm of Hon Hai/Foxconn Technology Group; non-healthcare core) launched a dedicated biotech investment push in 2021 focused on preventive medicine and precision testing, and in 2022 took over the H.Spectrum biomedical startup accelerator (originally founded 2016 by the Yonglin Foundation) as H.Spectrum+, deploying cumulative investment in the tens of billions of NT dollars.

summary.en: Precision-manufacturing subsidiary of Hon Hai/Foxconn Technology Group that began a dedicated biotech investment program in 2021 (preventive medicine, precision testing) and in 2022 took over the H.Spectrum biomedical accelerator (est. 2016) as H.Spectrum+, with cumulative biotech investment reported in the tens of billions of NT dollars.
